_comment: Example full server-only ad_creatives/{id} docs — one ordinary network creative, one promo (prepaid sponsor) creative. Import into the emulator or a real project with `firebase firestore:seed` style tooling of your choice — not wired up automatically. syncPublicCreative (functions) projects the public subset into ad_creatives_public from either shape. In practice, prefer creating/editing the promo one through the addPromoGame callable (functions/src/promoAdmin.ts) rather than writing this shape by hand — it fills in clicksCount/engagementsCount/spentCents/status/active correctly.

promo-acme-2026-09._comment: A prepaid, manually configured placement — see FIREBASE_SCHEMA.md's 'Promo (prepaid sponsor) fields' section. €500.00 prepaid at €1.00/click + €0.50/engagement; pinned first in the feed (priority) with a gold frame. playable.entry is a URL you host — never a file bundled into the app.
promo-acme-2026-09.title: Acme Adventure: Featured Launch

featured-fortress-siege._comment: The operator's own curated/bundled filler content — see FIREBASE_SCHEMA.md's placement row. No money fields (no prepaidAmountCents/rateCardCents/clicksCount/etc — those only exist on a promo doc), never billed by anything in promoSpendGuard.ts. Tracked identically to a network creative; the client scatters it to a random feed position on every load instead of pinning it.
